## Learning outcome

Explain how replication lag can produce a stale read.

::: {.notes}
Prerequisites: Lectures 03 and 05. This is a sample deck for the proposed syllabus, not a full lecture.
:::

## Worked scenario

A registration is written to a leader. An immediate read from a lagging replica still shows the old course list.

::: {.notes}
Replication stores related state on multiple nodes. With asynchronous replication, an acknowledged update may not yet be visible on every replica. The promised read behaviour must therefore be stated explicitly.
:::

## Discussion and recap

Which routing or synchronization choice could provide read-your-writes behaviour?

**Takeaway:** More copies do not by themselves define what a read is allowed to return.

::: {.notes}
Ask students to name assumptions before proposing a solution. The complete planned scope is recorded in the lecture brief.
:::
